service: Business One Stop Shop (BOSS) / Business Permit Issuance
description: Processes new business-permit applications through Meycauayan's Business One Stop Shop (BOSS).
typeOfTransaction: G2C / G2B - Government to Client / Government to Business
requirements: Accomplished business permit application form (original)
Tax Exemption Certificate, if exempt (original and photocopy)
Tax Clearance (original and photocopy)
Sanitary Permit and health certificates of food handlers, when applicable (original)
Barangay Business Clearance (original and photocopy)
Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (original or photocopy, as accepted by BOSS)
Applicable national-government permits or clearances (original and photocopy)
Other legal or industry-specific requirements applicable to the business
Special Power of Attorney, Board Resolution, or Secretary's Certificate for a representative (original and photocopy)
Valid IDs of the owner and representative; include specimen signatures where required
Current Community Tax Certificate/Cedula (original)
steps: Submit the application and complete requirements for assessment.
Pay the assessed amount at the City Treasurer's Office and obtain an official receipt.
Return the application and official receipt to BPLO for permit processing and release.

service: Locational Clearance/Certificate of Zoning Compliance for Building Permit Issuance
description: Locational or zoning clearance confirming that a proposed building project complies with the city's land-use plan and zoning rules.
officeDivision: Office of the City Planning and Development Coordinator
typeOfTransaction: G2C/G2B – Government to Client / Government to Business
requirements: Duly accomplished notarized application form (2 originals)
Complete architectural plans for new construction, or as-built architectural plans for renovation or alteration, signed and sealed by a licensed architect or engineer

Receive payment and issue an official receipt.
Prepare and sign the Locational Clearance.
Release the Locational Clearance.
